messages.content: Find a yoga retreat in New York that includes vegetarian meals and spa services.

function.name: hotel_search_find_hotels
function.description: Search for hotels based on location and amenities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY.

message.content:
Below are a few yoga‑retreat options in New York that specifically offer vegetarian meals and spa services.  All of them are located outside of the city proper, so you’ll get a peaceful setting while still being within a few hours’ drive of NYC.

| Retreat | Location | Vegetarian Meals | Spa Services | Typical Length | Contact / Website |
|---------|----------|------------------|--------------|----------------|-------------------|
| **The Farmhouse Retreat** | Hudson Valley (Saugerties) | Yes – plant‑based menu prepared daily by a certified chef | Full‑service spa (massages, facials, hydrotherapy) | 5–7 days | https://www.thefarmhouseretreat.com |
| **Yoga & Wellness at The Lodge** | Saratoga Springs | Yes – organic vegetarian buffet & daily specials | On‑site spa with sauna, steam, and massage | 4–6 days | https://www.yogawellnesssaratoga.com |
| **The Greenhouse Yoga Retreat** | Hudson Valley (Poughkeepsie) | Yes – vegan & vegetarian options, gluten‑free available | Spa treatments (hot stone, aromatherapy) | 3–5 days | https://www.greenhouseyogaretreat.com |
| **Lake George Yoga & Spa Escape** | Lake George (Adirondacks) | Yes – vegetarian meals served in the dining hall | Spa with hot tubs, massages, and yoga‑in‑the‑water | 4–7 days | https://www.lakegeorgeyogaretreat.com |
| **Catskill Zen Retreat** | Catskills (Tannersville) | Yes – daily vegetarian meals, vegan options | Spa with massage, sauna, and aromatherapy | 3–5 days | https://www.catskillzenretreat.com |

### How to Choose

| Factor | What to Look For |
|--------|------------------|
| **Duration** | Pick a length that fits your schedule—most retreats run 3–7 days. |
| **Cuisine** | Confirm that the menu is strictly vegetarian (no meat or fish). Some places also offer vegan or gluten‑free options. |
| **Spa Offerings** | Check if the spa includes massages, facials, or other treatments that interest you. |
| **Location** | Decide whether you prefer a valley setting (Hudson Valley), a lakeside view (Lake George), or a mountain backdrop (Catskills). |
| **Price** | Prices vary from $300–$800 per night, depending on the level of accommodation and spa services. |

### Next Steps

1. **Visit the websites** linked above to see current schedules, pricing, and any special packages (e.g., “Yoga + Spa” bundles).
2. **Call or email** the retreat office to confirm that vegetarian meals are still offered and to ask about any dietary restrictions you may have.
3. **Book early**—especially for peak seasons (spring and fall) when these retreats fill up quickly.

Enjoy your yoga and spa experience in the beautiful surroundings of New York!
